title: 第11章 通脉七重天第12章 让他死的痛快点
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
秦伏天再次闭关修炼。
上一次闭关，从通脉境三重天突破到五重天，经过这几日的沉淀，加之《龟息术》进一步夯实基础，修为境界已经得到彻底稳固。
所以又可以毫无顾虑地再次冲击新的境界了！
进入到石洞之中，秦伏天盘膝凝神，开始运转《吞天造化诀》，在丹田之处，造化神炉流转着道道神华，有着玄妙的道韵交织。
一株株灵草，以及一枚枚兽元，不断被炼化吸收，化成造化之水。
这一次耗费的时间更久了。
三十二株灵草，以及十一枚灵兽兽元，一共耗费了差不多两个时辰才完全炼化。
“乌狼的兽元所炼化的时间明显比一阶灵兽兽元炼化所需要的时间更长！”
“不过……生成的造化之水，也要远远多于一阶灵兽。”
这枚乌狼的兽元一共炼化生成了十三滴造化之水。
而其他那些灵草，以及兽元，一共炼化生成了四十二滴。
原本造化神炉当中，还剩余三滴。
也就是说，现在造化神炉当中一共有五十八滴造化之水！
“这么多造化之水，应该足够让我一次性突破到通脉境七重天了……”
秦伏天心念一动，造化神炉当中的造化之水便是悬浮出来，很快一滴一滴地融入到秦伏天的经脉，随着周身气血地流转，滋养四肢百骸……
与之同时，秦伏天体内的灵力，也在进一步地蜕变，变得更加凝实，更加精纯。
新的灵力很快便是开始不断冲击第六条经脉！
虽然说这具肉身之前已经修炼到了通脉境九重天。
但是上次落凤山的那场大战，受伤实在太过严重，丹田破碎之后，没有了灵力的流转和疏导，原本已经打通的筋脉再次郁结，也堆积了不少的杂质，甚至有些地方还形成了死结！
这使得秦伏天重新修炼的难度，反而比第一次要更大了！

不过好在这造化之水无比的神妙，同样也极为霸道。
经脉无法疏通之处，造化之水会直接将之摧毁，然后再生，形成新的经脉不仅仅更加坚固，而且也大了一圈，气血和灵气的运转变得更加畅通无阻！
当然这个过程也是极为痛苦的！
经脉和血肉地重生，以及骨骼的重组，都如同涅盘的过程。
这一次足足耗费了两天的时间！
而秦伏天也成功地从通脉五重天，直接提升到了通脉七重天！
“呼……”
长长吐了一口气，秦伏天紧绷的身体逐渐放松开来。
微微闭目，便能够感受到体内奔涌的气血。
灵气融合在血液之中，如同江洋之中的波涛，不断席卷，冲刷着全身的经脉！
同时，每一寸筋肉、骨骼，都充满了强横的力量！
“我现在虽然是通脉境七重天，但是实力比过去通脉九重天的时候也不知强大了多少。就算是初入气海境的武者，也无法挡住我一记炮拳吧？”
秦伏天心中思忖，他走到石洞之外，看着前方的石崖，嘭的一拳打出。
“轰！”
火芒闪烁，一记爆响。
content_en:
Qin Futian went into seclusion to practice again.
The last time I retreated, I broke through from the third level of the Tongmai Realm to the fifth level. After these few days of accumulation, and the "Turtle Breathing Technique" to further solidify the foundation, the cultivation realm has been completely stabilized.
So I can hit new realms again without any worries!
Entering the cave, Qin Futian crossed his knees and concentrated, and began to run the "Swallowing Heaven Creation Technique". In the Dantian, the divine furnace of creation was flowing with the divine flowers of Taoism, and there was a mysterious interweaving of Taoism.
Each spiritual grass and each beast element is continuously being refined and absorbed, turning into the water of creation.
This time it took longer.
Thirty-two spiritual grasses and eleven spiritual beast essences took a total of almost two hours to be completely refined.
"The time it takes to refine Wulang's beast essence is obviously longer than the time it takes to refine the beast essence of a first-level spirit beast!"
"However... the water of creation generated is far more than that of first-order spiritual beasts."
The beast essence of this black wolf was refined into a total of thirteen drops of water of creation.
The other spiritual herbs and beast essence were refined into a total of forty-two drops.
There were still three drops left in the divine furnace of creation.
In other words, there are now a total of fifty-eight drops of water of creation in the Divine Furnace of Creation!
"This much water of creation should be enough for me to break through to the seventh level of Tongmai Realm in one go..."
With Qin Futian's thought, the water of creation in the Divine Furnace of Creation was suspended, and soon integrated into Qin Futian's meridians drop by drop, nourishing the limbs and bones as the energy and blood flowed around the body...
At the same time, the spiritual power in Qin Futian's body was further transforming, becoming more solid and purer.
The new spiritual power soon began to continuously impact the sixth meridian!
Although this body has been cultivated to the ninth level of Tongmai Realm before.
But in the last battle at Luofeng Mountain, the injuries were too serious. After the Dantian was broken, there was no flow and channeling of spiritual power, and the tendons that had been opened became sluggish again, and a lot of impurities accumulated, and even dead knots were formed in some places!
This makes it more difficult for Qin Futian to practice again than the first time!
But fortunately, this water of creation is extremely magical, and it is also extremely domineering.
Where the meridians cannot be dredged, the water of creation will directly destroy them and then regenerate them. The new meridians formed are not only stronger, but also larger, making the circulation of qi, blood and spiritual energy more unimpeded!
Of course, this process is also extremely painful!
The rebirth of meridians, flesh and blood, and the reorganization of bones are all like the process of Nirvana.
This time it took two days!
And Qin Futian also successfully promoted from the fifth level of Tongmai to the seventh level of Tongmai!
"Huh..."
After taking a long breath, Qin Futian's tense body gradually relaxed.
Close your eyes slightly and you can feel the qi and blood rushing in your body.
The spiritual energy is integrated into the blood, like the waves in the ocean, constantly sweeping through, washing the meridians throughout the body!
At the same time, every inch of muscle and bone is full of tyrannical power!
"Although I am in the seventh level of Tongmai Realm now, my strength is much stronger than when I was in the ninth level of Tongmai Realm in the past. Even a warrior who has just entered the Qi Sea Realm can't block my cannon punch, right?"
Qin Futian was thinking in his heart. He walked outside the cave, looked at the rock cliff in front of him, and punched out with a bang.
"Boom!"
The fire flickered and there was an explosion.
